name: heartbeat

source.title: Heartbeat
source.author: acertingart
source.notes: 48 kHz stereo MP3, an hour of a resting heartbeat (50-55 a minute, beats 0.9-1.3 s apart), gated: digital silence between beats. Each beat a lub about 0.32 s long and a softer dub about 0.42 s after its start. Replaces a heartbeat of unknown source (possibly SoundBible's 'Heartbeat', Personal Use Only).

clips.notes: one lub-dub; the clip ends 0.81 s after the lub, in the silence after the dub, so the loop beats 74 times a minute as the old one did

shape: player.heartbeat loops while health is low (biomes.json, @player): the clip's length is the heart's rate. Level as the old clip's (loudest 50 ms -12.8 dB).
